derivation: the 39-crossing SUCCESS certificate (witness_chains/SUCCESS_13a_647.json) was minimised with marked Reidemeister moves and flypes to 15 crossings (kept below as intermediate_15), and then one pass move that reroutes a strand not passing through the marked crossing gives this 14-crossing diagram; the pass move commutes with the marked crossing change.  By Theorem 4.1 of the paper no 13-crossing (minimal) diagram can have a crossing change to 13a650, so 14 is the minimum.
